PlantRecord.title: PlantRecord
PlantRecord.description: An individual plant or group of the same species kept near a north-facing window in Barcelona, including photo, web-looked-up botanical details & care, lux readings & average daylight lux, pot properties, and watering schedule anchor.

id.description: Unique document ID for the plant or species group.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name for the plant or group.

botanicalName.description: Scientific/botanical Latin name identified from photo lookup.

careDetails.description: Web-grounded care instructions (watering cues, soil, humidity, Barcelona north-window notes, pet safety).

idealLuxMin.description: Minimum recommended indoor lux for this species.

idealLuxMax.description: Maximum recommended indoor lux for this species.

sourceTitle.description: Title of web reference source used for care lookup.

sourceUrl.description: HTTPS URL of web reference source used for care lookup.

entryType.description: Whether this record tracks a single plant or a group of the same species.

quantity.description: Number of plants in this entry (1 for individual, 2-200 for group).

potSize.description: Container size affecting soil moisture retention.

baseWaterDays.description: Baseline watering interval in days at 21C and 500 lux.

latestLux.description: Most recent recorded light intensity in lux.

avgLux.description: Running average of recorded lux readings for this plant.

luxReadingCount.description: Total number of lux readings recorded for this plant.

lastLuxMonth.description: Month key (YYYY-MM) of the most recent monthly lux reading.

luxSource.description: How the latest lux reading was obtained.

lastLuxAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the latest lux reading.

lastWateredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this plant or group was last watered.

snoozedUntilAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which watering is snoozed after a still-damp check, or empty string.

dampSnoozeCount.description: Count of still-damp snooze checks used to calibrate baseWaterDays.

notes.description: Optional user notes for this plant or group.

photoDataUrl.description: Compressed JPEG data URL captured by phone camera, or empty string.

PlantLog.title: PlantLog
PlantLog.description: Timestamped watering or lux measurement log entry for a plant or group.

luxValue.description: Measured lux value when logType is lux, or snapshot lux at watering.

readingPeriod.description: Whether lux reading was taken at Barcelona peak solar noon or general daytime.

MonthlyTemp.title: MonthlyTemp
MonthlyTemp.description: Monthly indoor room temperature and humidity log for the Barcelona north-facing apartment.

avgTempC.description: Average room temperature in Celsius (5 to 42).

minTempC.description: Typical nighttime low room temperature in Celsius (0 to 40).

maxTempC.description: Typical afternoon high room temperature in Celsius (5 to 45).

humidityPct.description: Estimated indoor relative humidity percentage (15 to 95).

daylightHours.description: Recorded effective average daylight hours per day for this month (0.5 to 18).

PlantGrowthPhoto.title: PlantGrowthPhoto
PlantGrowthPhoto.description: Timestamped progress photo and AI growth/health diagnosis for tracking plant development over time.

photoDataUrl.description: Compressed JPEG data URL of the plant progress photo.

healthStatus.description: Overall plant growth and health state.

growthSummary.description: Observed growth progress and foliage vigor.

issueDetected.description: What appears wrong if growth is not optimal, or empty string.

recommendedAction.description: Actionable care adjustment for Barcelona north-window conditions.

avgLuxSnapshot.description: Plant average daylight lux at the time of photo.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the photo was captured.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}.description: User-owned plant or species group records.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}/logs/{l.description: Watering and lux measurement log entries for a plant or group.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}/growthP.description: Chronological plant progress photos with growth & health diagnosis.

/users/{userId}/monthlyTemps/{monthId}.description: Monthly room temperature and air humidity records for Barcelona apartment microclimate.
